name: a-da
author: a_da team
description: A local AI coding agent: pure Rust core + Electron desktop host + React UI

scripts.electron:build:main: bun build ./electron/main.ts --target node --format cjs --outfile dist-electron/main.cjs --external=electron && bun build ./electron/preload.ts --target node --format cjs --outfile dist-electron/preload.cjs --external=electron
scripts.electron:build: npm --prefix tauri-ui run build && bun run electron:build:main && node --experimental-require-module ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win dir && bun tools/heal-electron-perms.ts
scripts.electron:dist: npm --prefix tauri-ui run build && bun run electron:build:main && node --experimental-require-module ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win nsis
scripts.electron:pack: npm --prefix tauri-ui run build && bun run electron:build:main && node --experimental-require-module ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win dir && bun tools/heal-electron-perms.ts
